youtube.title: Who REALLY said "let them eat cake"? Marie Antoinette has receipts 🍰 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Marie Antoinette never said "let them eat cake" and she just found out who did. 🍰

Rousseau put a "great princess" brioche line in his Confessions... when Marie was a kid in Austria.

Is Rousseau the real villain here? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: the "qu'ils mangent de la brioche" line appears in Rousseau's Confessions, written years before Marie Antoinette ever arrived in France. There is no evidence she said it.
